headline: Kyrgyzstan and Kazakhstan intend to increase trade turnover to $3 billion
summary: Kyrgyzstan and Kazakhstan plan to raise mutual trade to $3 billion by 2030, according to Kyrgyzstan's Ministry of Economy and Commerce. The target was announced by the ministry.
why: Regional trade targets signal the direction of cross-border trade flows in Central Asia, which matters for exporters and logistics operators in the region.
original_headline: Кыргызстан и Казахстан намерены увеличить товарооборот до 3 миллиардов долларов
